subject: POC kickoff: Hands-on lab & network preflight for Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@nimbushealth.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-15T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff: Hands-on lab & network preflight for Nimbus Health

Hi Alex / Maya —

Thanks for confirming interest in the hands-on POC. We want to line up two coordinated sessions: a short preflight load test to validate routing/throughput and then the hands-on workshop where we’ll run prompts, routing scenarios, and an interactive debugging session. Proposed windows (PT):

- Tuesday, Aug 24 — Preflight load tests 09:00–10:30 PT
- Thursday, Aug 26 — Hands-on lab 10:00–11:30 PT (includes prompt review and routing dry run)

Can you confirm which of those works for your team? Also pls provide the following so our infra team can prep:

- Firewall egress allowlist (IPs/CIDRs) and firewall contact for scheduling network rules
- Any VPC/VPN details if you plan to use Private mode or PrivateLink
- Expected concurrency for the lab (rough RPS) and typical prompt sizes (tokens) so we can tune batching and KV cache
- Confirm whether you want us to use a synthetic dataset during the lab (recommended if PHI is involved)

I attached a short runbook (redwood-poc-runbook-v1.pdf) that outlines what we’ll run during the two sessions. We can also do a 20‑minute prompt rehearsal with your product folks the day before the hands-on session to make sure example prompts and tool-calling behaviors are aligned.

Thanks — once we have allowlist details we’ll request sandbox creds from our infra and schedule the preflight.

— Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Camila — thanks for the clear plan. Aug 26 at 10:00 PT works better for our product and ops teams. We can do the preflight on Aug 24 as suggested but would prefer the window 09:30–10:30 PT if that helps with our engineering schedules.

Quick answers:
- Firewall egress: we’ll provide the allowed egress IPs by tomorrow (our network team needs to confirm).
- VPC/PrivateLink: not required for this POC — we’ll use a staging sandbox with synthetic data.
- Expected concurrency: assume 8–12 concurrent users, average prompt size ~350 tokens, with some longer prompts ~1k tokens for stress cases.

I’m looping in Maya (security) and our firewall contact (jfryer@nimbushealth.com) who will supply the allowlist. Also cc’ing procurement in case we need an updated SOW/DocuSign link.

— Alex

Alex / Maya —

Thanks — 10:00 PT on Thu Aug 26 is good for our folks. We’ll plan the preflight on Tue Aug 24 at 09:30 PT per your preference.

A couple of infra asks to prepare the load test and routing checks:
- Please confirm peak RPS (requests per second) you want us to simulate and whether the 8–12 concurrent user estimate represents steady-state or burst.
- Provide any IP ranges for upstream services that the POC calls (if you have in-house services that will be invoked) so we can whitelist them too.
- Do you need us to use a specific model variant or quantized profile? For the lab we typically run two variants (standard and quantized) to show cost/latency tradeoffs.

We’ll also run an automated prefix/KV cache smoke test and a short trace capture during the preflight to validate routing policies. Please attach sandbox creds to a reply or the ticket — if you prefer, you can also drop them into the sandbox-credentials.txt attachment.

Diego

Subject: Confirmed: Preflight + Hands-on lab schedule + preflight checklist

Alex / Maya —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the allowlist and sandbox creds. Confirming schedule:

- Preflight load test: Tue Aug 24, 09:30–10:30 PT (Diego will run throughput and routing checks)
- Prompt rehearsal (optional): Wed Aug 25, 09:00–09:30 PT (short sync for example prompts)
- Hands-on lab: Thu Aug 26, 10:00–11:30 PT (prompt review, routing scenarios, interactive debugging)

Preflight checklist (what we’ll validate):
- Network: egress allowlist applied and connectivity verified (we will run curl/https smoke tests)
- Auth: sandbox credentials validated and scoped to synthetic data only
- Load: simulated 12 concurrent users, burst to 30 RPS for 2 minutes to validate autoscaling/fallbacks
- Routing: canary routing test across model variants and default fallback behavior
- Observability: token-level latency/p50/p95 traces and cost breakdown captured

Attachments: redwood-poc-runbook-v1.pdf (detailed agenda and command snippets) and sandbox-credentials.txt (received). I’ve uploaded the runbook to the Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1nimbus-poc-runbook and linked the HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890.

Stephanie, can you lead the prompt review on Wed if Alex/Maya are available? Aditya, I’m copying you to flag the load test — we may need a short reserved capacity bump for the stress window (will follow up on cost).

If anything changes on your side (egress ranges or scheduling), please let us know ASAP. Otherwise we’ll consider this confirmed and will share a short runbook and calendar invites imminently.

Best —
